rows.title: Terms from the pasted line
rows.test: the minimum, expiry and enroll-by are the pasted ones

rows.title: Missing terms said missing
rows.defect: a missing expiry reads as "expires soon"
rows.test: no expiry and no cap are said

rows.title: An amount it can't place
rows.defect: unplaced amounts are ignored and the reward is stated
rows.test: "$50 in gift cards" stops the earnings line

rows.title: No look-alike match
rows.defect: a row prefix matches without a word boundary
rows.test: TARGET offer vs TARGETED ADS LLC

rows.title: Descriptor variants match
rows.defect: the plural/possessive S is not folded
rows.test: WALGREENS offer vs WALGREEN PHARMACY row

rows.title: Use-anyway needs a habit
rows.defect: a single purchase counts as a habit
rows.test: one purchase is out of the way

rows.title: The 180-day window
rows.test: March and April purchases are left out

rows.title: Pending, other currency, transfers left out
rows.defect: the purchase check accepts pending rows, any currency and transfers
rows.test: only the posted USD purchase counts

rows.title: Typical is the median
rows.defect: the typical purchase is the largest

rows.title: A card that isn't linked is said
rows.defect: any linked card counts as the issuer's
rows.test: BankAmeriDeals with only Amex and Chase linked

rows.title: The offer's own card
rows.defect: purchases on any account count as on the offer's card
rows.test: paid with Chase and checking, the offer is on the Amex

rows.title: No push to spend
rows.test: out-of-the-way says count only spending you'd do anyway

rows.title: Offer lists only
rows.test: a dispute that mentions an offer is not an offer list

rows.title: A question is not a paste
rows.defect: a one-line question is read as an offer list
rows.test: "any offers with 5% back at costco, should i add one?"
